proposals.evidence: CDIAL 994 ahi explicitly gives Khowar aī snake, analyzed through *ahika. These āī snake forms follow that explicit comparison; the k-extension is retained in evidence under the existing ahi family node. Exact survey form āī is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
